decision.reasoning_trace: I am specifically looking for a durable daypack for hiking and outdoor use. While the feed contains many non-backpack items such as stoves, chairs, and towels, I identified five relevant products. I excluded the hydration pack (prod_backpacks_196) due to reported bladder leaks and the mesh bag (prod_backpacks_128) for low outdoor durability. The KAILAS 28L (prod_backpacks_043) is the strongest candidate because of its internal frame for ventilation and included rain cover, which are premium features. Reviews comparing it favorably to high-end brands like Osprey convinced me it is the best value for its price point.
